classificationDecision: SaaS: a B2B employee-recognition product sold per active user with a trial, demo booking, integrations and a login. It is not a consumer app or a marketplace, so the common SaaS policy applies.
generationRules: PageSpecs declare mode: clone | generation. Generation mode must contain no real Evergreen brand, logo, icons / brand artwork, product screenshots, badges / certifications, proprietary assets, copy, claims, URLs, people or customers (GENERATION_MODE_* rules).
Pages are composed only from the 22 templates and 47 section contracts; pricing, demo and comparison pages follow their measured templates.
Only generation-safe asset roles in generation mode (placeholder assets, generated illustrations / icons, operator-supplied assets); availability is pinned in code.
Token references use tokens/llm/token-catalog.json names only; no raw colours, arbitrary spacing or unsupported fonts.
Runtime UI (trial modal, announcement banner) is never retrieved as a section.
contentHashNote: registry.manifest.json designPolicy.contentHash is sha256 over the enforcedBy files in the order listed (each as '<path>\n' + bytes + '\n'). extraction/verify_all.py recomputes it and fails on a mismatch; extraction/policy_hash.py --write updates it after an intended change.

approval.note: The SaaS classification and binding are an agent's evidence-based decision; no human architecture owner has ratified it. The common policy's own content is not vendored here.
